blocks.text: Yeh chapter online research, digital literacy aur intellectual property ka poora overview deta hai aur in fields ki zaroori skills aur concepts (khayalat) par zor deta hai. Shuru mein online research ki ahmiyat aur research ke alag alag tareeqe (types) bataye gaye. Phir digital literacy aati hai: technology ka istemal, maloomat dhoondna (information retrieval), sources ko parakhna, digital content banana, aur online safety aur privacy. Chapter advanced information retrieval techniques (Boolean operators, filters) aur research inquiries banana, yani research questions aur hypotheses, bhi samjhata hai. Aakhir mein digital resources ka istemal, research ethics, aur intellectual property ki qismein, patents, trademarks, copyrights, industrial designs aur trade secrets, aur creative aur naye kaam ki hifazat mein in ki ahmiyat bayan ki gayi hai.

items: Online research: maqsad ke hisab se paanch qismein; reliable sources aur kai sources ka muqabla.
Digital literacy ke paanch components; advanced search: keywords, AND/OR/NOT, filters.
Achhe research questions aur hypothesis; online libraries aur peer-reviewed journals.
Research ethics ke usool; intellectual property ki paanch qismein aur un ki hifazat (IPO Pakistan).
